onboarding.welcomeTitle: A Paid Rotation in City Government, for Credit
onboarding.welcomeBody: You will spend one semester, 10 to 12 paid hours a week, in a city office matched to your major. A preceptor guides you, a director meets with you monthly, and your work becomes a record you can use to get hired.
onboarding.consentTitle: Your Record and Who Sees It
onboarding.consentParticipation: I agree to take part in Teaching City and for my college and the city to share my enrollment, hours and course credit status with each other.
onboarding.consentCityHr: I agree that City of Westbrook HR can see my ratings, notes, evidence and work samples so I can join the hiring lane when I finish.
onboarding.consentNote: You can change who sees your record later in Settings. Turning off City HR sharing removes you from the hiring lane.
onboarding.consentRequired: Both boxes are needed to join the program.
onboarding.availabilityBody: Pick the hours you are free on weekdays. You need at least 10.
onboarding.availabilityTooFew: Pick at least 10 hours so a teaching unit can fit you.
onboarding.coursesBody: List courses you have taken. We use them to show which city roles connect to what you have learned.
onboarding.optionalBody: These help the program check that it reaches students who need it most. Only you can see your answers. Reports show totals of 5 or more people, never individuals.
onboarding.consentDemographic: Use my answers in program totals
onboarding.firstGen: I am the first in my family to go to college
onboarding.adultLearner: I am an adult learner or changing careers
onboarding.finished: You are all set. The city will confirm your match soon.
